newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-North sees stronger second half.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-North sees stronger second half.

text.p: Resources group North Ltd said on Friday that it saw a stronger second half performance and that its result for the full year to June 30, 1997, would not be much different to that posted in 1995/96.

"Although the second half should see improved contributions from most of the operations, present expectations are for the full year result to be not significantly different to last year's (net) profit of A$111.9 million," North managing director Campbell Anderson said in a statement.
North posted a net profit of A$50 million for the six months to December 31, up from A$33 million a year earlier.
North shares barely moved on the profit announcement, which followed news of North's US$230 million acquisition of one of Canada's major iron ore producer, The Iron Ore Co of Canada.
The stock was trading at A$3.95 near the end of trading, up three cents on Thursday's close.
